properties.evidence: Read both, 2026-09-09, in answer to a possible_duplicate gap. They are NOT the same finding — they are the two ends of one mechanism. B is the MECHANISM: upgrading the binary does not replace the process serving it, and every signal a user would check looks current (Alex, macOS, 2026-08-29, with the authoritative objects read). A is the CONSEQUENCE: an agent on that stale surface filed a bug that had been fixed eighteen hours earlier, because it could not name its own version. Recording CAUSES keeps both — the mechanism is what you fix, the consequence is what tells you it matters — where merging them would lose whichever half the merged text did not keep.
